_comment: Templates per workspace. Email bodies are NOT stored here — they live as a visual-designer pair at suprsend/templates/<slug>/email/default/body.designer.{html,json}, generated by scripts/make-designs.mjs from the `heading`/`paragraph`/`button` fields below. Run make-designs before provision.mjs templates. Per-recipient values must come from {{$recipient.*}}: broadcast `data` is identical for every recipient, so {{$recipient.name}} is the only safe way to personalise a broadcast. The welcome templates carry NO sampleData on purpose: their workflow is triggered by list entry, and $USER_ENTERED_LIST is emitted by SuprSend rather than by this app, so there is no payload to fill custom variables from. They template on $recipient and $brand only. Anything needing per-send values must be triggered by an event this app emits, or sent as a broadcast. A template with `broadcastCategory` can be sent as a broadcast, under that category — SuprSend templates carry no category of their own and a broadcast has to name one, so the seed records it here. The category must be promotional (a broadcast on a transactional or system category holds up that category's other traffic) and it is not a per-send choice, since the category decides whose opt-outs apply. Templates without it are still perfectly sendable — by a workflow, which names its own category.
